auftrag: Read the menu and the note. Then solve five puzzles.

saetze: Today only: a free biscuit with every tea
The locker is at the back of the café.
First: the price of the cheapest drink.
Second: the price of the carrot cake.
Third: the price of the toastie minus the price of a tea.
Last night somebody left a small parcel in the locker and asked me to keep it safe.
The person was in a big hurry and did not give a name.

raetsel.frage: What is the code for the locker?
raetsel.hilfe1: Find the cheapest drink first. Then the cake. For the third number you must subtract.

raetsel.frage: True or false? “Sam knows the name of the person with the parcel.”
raetsel.hilfe1: Read the last sentence of the note.
raetsel.hilfe2: Sam says: ... did not give a name.
raetsel.rtyp: True, false or not in the text

raetsel.frage: Tap the sentence that tells you what the person asked Sam to do.
raetsel.hilfe2: It is the first sentence of the second paragraph.

raetsel.frage: Why did the person leave the parcel in the café?
optionen: The person wanted to buy a cake.
It is a safe place to hide it.
raetsel.hilfe1: Think: why do people ask others to "keep it safe"?
raetsel.hilfe2: The person was in a hurry and wanted to hide the parcel.

raetsel.frage: Read the short text about Sam. Choose the right words.
raetsel.text: Every morning Sam ___ the café at seven. He ___ tea and ___ the cakes. His friends ___ him at nine.
raetsel.hilfe1: Sam is one person. His friends are many people.
raetsel.hilfe2: One person (he, she, it) needs an -s. Many people (they) do not.
